description: Publish a DRAFT conference so it becomes publicly visible: it appears in the directory, its pages resolve, and its call for papers opens to authors. No emails are sent. This is the first irreversible-feeling step, so always confirm with the user before calling it. IMPORTANT two-step behaviour: call it first WITHOUT acknowledgeMissing. If required setup is incomplete the conference is NOT published and you get back a list of what is missing — relay that list to the user in plain language and ask whether to publish anyway. Only if they say yes, call again passing those exact keys as acknowledgeMissing. Never invent or guess those keys: if they do not match what is actually missing the call is refused. A conference that is already live returns an error saying so. Requires the organization API key to be configured; without one this returns an error telling the user where to create a key.

acknowledgeMissing.description: ONLY the setup item keys a previous call reported as missing, copied verbatim after the user agreed to publish anyway. Omit on the first call.

eventId.description: Event UUID from list_my_events — not the URL slug.

name: publish_conference
title: Take a draft conference live
